title: {{recv_tool}} — output
description: Output schema for the SOX recv (drain) operation. Messages are returned in per-channel send-time order (ascending sent_at within each channel). Cross-channel order within a single response is unspecified. Each returned message is atomically marked as delivered to the calling agent — it will not be returned to the same agent again. Normative reference: CONTRACTS.md §5.2, spec/ports/backing-store.md §2.2 and §3.2.

drained_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which this drain operation completed.

messages.description: Ordered list of messages drained. Empty array is valid when the mailbox is empty. Within each channel, messages are in ascending sent_at order. Across channels, order is unspecified.

channel.description: Name of the channel this message was sent to.

sender.description: agent_id of the agent that sent the message. In v1.0 with identity enforcement, this is a server-certified value. Without identity enforcement, it is self-reported.

body.description: Opaque message payload. See send.input.schema.json for advisory field conventions and spec/envelopes/ for reserved body types.

correlation_id.description: Caller-supplied correlation token echoed verbatim from the send call. Null if the sender did not supply one.

sent_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the backing store accepted the message.

message_id.description: Backing-store-assigned unique identifier for this message.
